items.title: 老爸vibecode出「安全版Roblox」：录像假装联机、ChatGPT机器人陪聊——616万浏览
items.en_title: I vibecoded a safer Roblox for my son. The game is populated with recordings of other play throughs (giving the illusion of playing with others). And there's even a chat from the bots talking to each other.
items.full_text:
I vibecoded a safer Roblox for my son

He’s not allowed to play Roblox because we don’t know who he’s talking to

So I created a version where he plays obbys

The game is populated with recordings of other play throughs (giving the illusion of playing with others)

And there’s even a chat from the bots talking to each other. He can talk with the bots and they chat back using chatgpt
items.author: Adam Lyttle
items.summary: 开发者Adam Lyttle为儿子打造的「安全版Roblox」：孩子不被允许玩Roblox是因为不知道在跟谁聊天，于是他自己做了一个版本——孩子玩obby跑酷，游戏里用其他玩家通关录像「扮演」联机队友，制造与真人同玩的错觉；还有机器人互相聊天的频道，孩子可以和它们对话（后端接ChatGPT）。推文616万浏览、1.7万赞。
items.analysis: 在Roblox股价暴跌70%、儿童安全诉讼缠身的同一周，这条推文击中了家长焦虑的最大公约数：「假联机+AI陪聊」是一个聪明的折中——保留社交错觉、移除陌生人风险。对UGC平台团队：这是家长视角的「安全模式」需求原型；对AI团队：录像+LLM bot的轻量组合，是单机游戏模拟多人氛围的低成本方案。
items.recommendation: 老爸vibecode「安全版Roblox」：录像伪装联机+AI陪聊——616万浏览

items.title: Grok Bot实测：2小时生成74个美术资产并接回游戏；每个Bot配16GB+128GB云电脑
items.en_title: I've been using Grok Bot in early access for a little over a week now... In about 2 hours, it generated 74 (cleaned and cropped) art assets for the cards and integrated all of them into my game.
items.full_text:
I’ve been using Grok Bot in early access for a little over a week now, and it has been a massive boost to my game dev workflow and my productivity in general.

One of the first things I asked it to do was to visit my custom art generation tool webpage and generate art assets to replace all the image placeholders in my game.

It looked through my codebase to understand what each asset was, wrote a custom art generation prompt for every single one, generated the images, cropped and cleaned them up into transparent PNGs, and then wired them back into the game.

In about 2 hours, it generated 74 (cleaned and cropped) art assets for the cards and integrated all of them into my game. Now, ALL my art assets workflows go through Grok bot.

This blew my mind because, before this, I was doing everything manually, one asset at a time. It basically solved my entire art asset workflow and allowed me to put it on autopilot, which is amazing.

I’ve also been using Grok Bot for:

Playtesting my game: The bot was a little slow initially, so I asked it to build a skill specifically designed to playtest my game, with intimate knowledge of its rules and mechanics. It’s much faster now, though I’m still looking for ways to optimise its speed.

Setting up my itchio page for my game: It also automated a workflow that uploads a new build to itch whenever I push one to GitHub. Going to the itch website and uploading builds manually every single time was always a pain.

Flowcharts and UX design: I’m a UX designer by day, so I decided to give it a much bigger task. I fed the agent a PRD and asked it to design the UX flows and wireframes. With the help of the Figma MCP, it actually delivered.

Auditing all my paid subscriptions: I had it go through my emails and hunt down subscriptions that I might have forgotten about.

Unsubscribing me from marketing newsletters: It did this beautifully, though it did miss a few newsletters.

What I’ve learned is that it takes time to discover all the possible use cases for Grok bot. I’ve had to reevaluate my day-to-day workflows and figure out which parts I can delegate to it.

So far, it has been a huge productivity unlock for me and I am discovering more uses for my Grok bots every other day.
items.author: Danny Limanseta
items.summary: Danny Limanseta的Grok Bot抢先体验：让它访问自研美术生成工具页，它先通读代码库理解每个占位图、为每个资产写生成prompt、生成后裁剪清理成透明PNG、再接回游戏——2小时完成74个美术资产全流程，「现在我所有美术工作流都走Grok Bot」。Tony出海同日拆解配置：每个Grok Bot自带一台16GB内存+128GB存储的Debian云电脑（预装Chrome），「给每个AI队友配了专属Linux云电脑」——Manus路线的回归。
items.analysis: 「每个agent一台云电脑」的配置把bot从聊天框里解放出来，变成能浏览网页、操作工具的执行体——Danny的资产流水线案例是目前最具体的游戏开发落地。对美术管线团队：占位图→AI生成→自动接入的闭环已经可以做到小时级。
items.recommendation: Grok Bot实测：2小时74个美术资产入库；每个Bot一台云电脑——4.5万浏览

items.title: Levie论FDE：AI是把非确定性系统塞进从未被自动化的工作流
items.en_title: The key is that FDEs are real and not going away for AI any time soon... 'Nobody knows what the user journey looks like — not you, and importantly, not your customer either.'
items.full_text:
Good post on how to think about FDEs. The key is that FDEs are real and not going away for AI any time soon.

The reason this is happening now at a scale that has never been seen before is because AI is fundamentally about adding a non-deterministic, rapidly changing system to workflows that largely have never been automated before. This looks very little like implementing traditional software.

“If you're building an AI agent for accounting in 2026, there is no established workflow, because literally nobody has ever used one of these. Nobody knows what the user journey looks like — not you, and importantly, not your customer either. They can't tell you what they want, because the thing they'd want doesn't have a shape yet.”

Software has largely always been deterministic and once implemented effectively worked the same for customers. This meant the upfront implementation work was *relatively* uniform across similar customers, and the system wasn’t regularly being upgraded in fundamental ways. 

AI agents are entirely different on nearly every dimension. The customer’s business process has to change to work with agents, there is heavy -necessary- customization to get agents to work in the customers end-state process, evals need to be run constantly, the AI models are constantly changing and updates need to keep getting incorporated, the underlying harness and broader system are often changing due to customer feedback, and much more. 

This is real work for the customer, systems integrators, and the applied AI vendors. Even as AI capabilities improve dramatically, this work remains (or even gets more complicated) given enterprises will just throw increasingly more complex processes at agents. Great time to be an FDE.
items.author: Aaron Levie
items.summary: Box CEO Levie转评FDE（Forward Deployed Engineer，前线部署工程师）模式：AI FDE规模空前的原因在于——AI是把非确定性、快速变化的系统加入「从未被自动化过」的工作流，与传统软件实施完全不同。引用观察：「2026年做会计agent，没有现成工作流可言，因为没人用过这种东西——没人知道用户旅程长什么样，你和你的客户都不知道，因为那个东西还没有形状。」10万浏览。
items.analysis: 对AI toB团队：FDE模式的本质是「产品未定型前先派人」——当用户旅程尚不存在，标准售前/交付流程失效，只能把工程师扔进客户现场共同定义流程。这也是评估AI初创交付成本结构的关键科目。
items.recommendation: Levie论FDE：AI实施没有现成工作流——「东西还没有形状」——10万浏览

items.title: Xbox七月outage原因查明：连实体盘都无法游玩的bug已修复，8/17强制更新
items.en_title: Xbox promises that the causes of the recent outage, which rendered even game discs unplayable, have been fixed
items.full_text:
Xbox promises that the causes of the recent outage, which rendered even game discs unplayable, have been fixed

https://t.co/osF3KXa2DJ https://t.co/Pa3tmc5xOs
items.author: Eurogamer
items.summary: Xbox CTO Scott Van Vliet公布七月大故障调查结论：外部依赖服务故障+自身一个独立bug叠加，把许可证检查服务一并拖垮——导致连实体盘游戏都无法启动。bug已修复并推送客户端更新（8/17起强制）；Xbox已接管该许可服务的所有权，继续「加固服务与基础设施」。Eurogamer点题：「当光盘消失、数字成为唯一获取方式，类似故障足以让整个主机生态瘫痪」。
items.analysis: 「实体盘也打不开」是本周实体盘叙事最锋利的实锤：物理介质早已不是离线保障——许可证校验在线化的现实，比索尼停盘计划本身更值得放进风险评估。对平台团队：许可服务的降级策略（离线宽限）是关键的韧性设计。
items.recommendation: Xbox outage复盘：实体盘也无法游玩的bug已修复——在线验证的韧性课
